title: Roadmap Towards Quantum Entanglement Positron Emission Tomography (QE-PET)
summary: Annihilation photons are quantum entangled in their polarization, a property that is not accessible in state-of-the-art clinical Positron Emission Tomography (PET). This roadmap describes the current status of research in the emerging field of quantum entanglement applications involving these photons for medical diagnosis. It outlines the underlying physics phenomena and the development of detector systems that can serve as a foundation for future Quantum Entanglement PET (QE-PET) scanners.
